description: This file defines the PrismaAuditActorRepository class, which implements IAuditActorRepository. It provides methods to find or create audit actor records in a database using Prisma ORM, handling different actor types such as user, guest, attendee, and app.

classes.name: PrismaAuditActorRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing audit actor records in the database using Prisma ORM.

methods.name: findByUserUuid
methods.description: Finds an audit actor by user UUID.

methods.name: createIfNotExistsUserActor
methods.description: Creates a user actor record if it does not already exist.

methods.name: createIfNotExistsGuestActor
methods.description: Creates or updates a guest actor record based on email or phone, or creates a new guest record if none found.

methods.name: createIfNotExistsAttendeeActor
methods.description: Creates an attendee actor record if it does not already exist.

methods.name: createIfNotExistsAppActor
methods.description: Creates or updates an app actor record based on credentialId or email.
